notes: Settled policy. Budgets are soft: exceeding one checkpoints the issue for explicit reconciliation.
Batch-3 observed maxima: implement 13.3M input / 75k output / 125 tool calls / 2793 s; review 2.3M input / 16k output / 48 tool calls / 575 s.
implement 15M/150k/250 and 5400 s leave headroom above those maxima; repair is about a third of implement.
review 5M/40k/120 matches the last working batch-3 budget; 1800 s is about three times the slowest observed review.
max_repairs 2 is the engine's upper bound, shared across resumes and profiles; each check may run 1800 s.

Proposed, not yet settled (W-181): bounded_sessions is off. When enabled, a worker session whose cumulative input reached input_threshold_tokens, or (handoff_after_implement) the first repair after implement, continues in a fresh session seeded with a handoff file instead of resuming the long one. The 5M threshold is a proposal: batch-3 implement sessions above it (the W-170 resume, W-171, W-172) were the ones whose context approached the model window.
